newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold gets mild boost from dollar in '96.
newsitem.headline: Ahold gets mild boost from dollar in '96.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV -- which generates over half of its sales in the United States -- said on Thursday a firmer dollar gave a slight boost to its reported earnings in guilders in 1996.
The dollar was worth an average of 1.69 guilders in 1996 versus 1.61 in 1995.
If exchange rates had remained stable, 1996 net earnings in guilders would have been 35.2 percent higher than in 1995 rather than the actual reported increase of 38.5 percent, it said.
The dollar had a more pronounced impact during the fourth quarter when it was worth an average of 1.72 guilders versus 1.60 in the same period of 1995.
If exchange rates had remained stable, fourth quarter net earnings in guilders would have been 58.1 percent higher rather than the actual reported increase of 62.8 percent, it said.
The dollar has recently been trading at levels above 1.90 guilders.
